observations.body: The signed-out employee portal shows Username and Password fields and a Sign in button.
The signed-out form is ready with the Employee username and configured password to submit.
Submitting Employee credentials opened the authenticated dashboard with navigation and quick actions.
Dashboard shows navigation to Directory, My Leave, Timesheet and My Profile, plus Request leave, Fill timesheet and Log out controls.
Selecting Timesheet from authenticated navigation opened the employee timesheet for the week of Sep 14, 2026.
New leave request offers Vacation, Sick and Personal leave types; start date, end date and optional Reason fields; Submit request and Cancel. It states weekends are not counted.
The leave request form is blank, with Vacation selected and no leave request to create for this validation check.
Submitting the blank leave form showed “Please fill in all required fields.” and stayed on New leave request.
Timesheet shows a draft for week of Sep 14, 2026 with Monday through Sunday hour inputs all at 0, total 0 h, and Save draft and Submit week buttons.
The Sep 14, 2026 draft has 8 hours entered for Monday, 0 on other days, and total 8 h; it is evaluation data.
Save draft kept the Sep 14, 2026 timesheet at 8 total hours and displayed “Draft saved.” The saved hours are evaluation data.
My profile shows Upload photo; editable Full name, Phone and Emergency contact fields; a disabled Email field; and Save changes.

Employee directory loads 28 employees. It offers name search, an All departments selector with Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Finance and HR, a Name sort header, and pagination showing page 1 of 3 with Previous disabled and Next available. Rows expose name, department, title and email.
Searching the directory for “Emily Dawson” reduced the result to one Engineering Software Engineer row and page 1 of 1.

My leave offers New request and shows 18 available days, noting days are deducted when approved. Request history contains an approved Vacation request for Aug 18–19, 2026 displayed as 3 days with manager comment “Approved – enjoy!”.
